DLNR DOFAW Wildland Urban Interface (WUI) Grant Program
Wildfire risk grants open to local gov agencies incl. county FDs; 50/50 match. Last listed deadline 12/20/2024.
Hawaii Urban Interface (HUI) Wildfire Grant Program (DLNR/HWMO)
State-funded, up to $300K, 25% match; local gov agencies eligible. FY26-27 round closed Apr 20, 2026.
IDL Rural Fire Capacity (RFC) Grant (formerly VFA)
90/10 match for training, PPE, equipment; 80%+ volunteer depts favored. Last deadline June 1, 2026 at local IDL office.
50/50 match for PPE, hose, radios; pop. 10,000 or less, 80% volunteer. Last deadline July 1, 2026.
DNR Forest Service Volunteer Fire Assistance (VFA) Grant
50/50 wildland gear grant, max $3,500. Page says 2026 cycle closes Nov 25, 2026 4pm but also lists Sept 15; confirm.
Senator William H. Amoss Fire, Rescue and Ambulance Fund
$16.5M/yr formula aid paid to counties (~Nov 15) and passed to volunteer companies; apply via your county, no state window.
~$5M reimbursement grant for PPE, hose, radios, TICs. FY27 not yet posted; FY26 window was Jan 21-Feb 19, 2026.
Fire/life safety education grants for kids and seniors ($1.8M). FY27 deadline was Sept 29, 2026; next round tbd.
Up to $9,500 for wildland gear; MFC covers match; pop. under 10,000, 80% volunteer. Last deadline Mar 4, 2026.
Cost-share for training, equipment, organizing; submitted via county fire warden. Last window Apr 1-Jun 1, 2026.
DNRC Volunteer Fire Assistance (VFA, IIJA) Grant
IIJA-funded rural VFD grant; opens only if funding awarded. Last window Dec 1, 2025-Feb 1, 2026.
Nebraska Forest Service Volunteer Fire Assistance (VFA)
Up to 50% reimbursement, max $5,000, for wildland gear/training; fire reporting must be current. Opens annually in April.
